UADataType.Description: The kind of WoT document a resource carries: a Thing Description (a concrete instance) or a Thing Model (a reusable type template). All is a selector-only wildcard, never a stored DocumentKind, result Kind or creation kind.

Field.Name: ThingDescription
Field.Description: A W3C WoT Thing Description (WoT-TD/1.1); projects to OPC UA instances.

Field.Name: ThingModel
Field.Description: A W3C WoT Thing Model (WoT-TM/1.1); projects to OPC UA types.

Field.Name: All
Field.Description: Select both document kinds. Valid only in selector Kind after compatible model/capability discovery.

UADataType.Description: The lifecycle state of a WoT document's derived projection in the AddressSpace. The registry file always remains stored; this enum reflects only the state of the code-behind projection.

Field.Name: Unloaded
Field.Description: Stored but not projected into the AddressSpace.

Field.Name: Validating
Field.Description: Format and compatibility validation is in progress.

Field.Name: Loading
Field.Description: The projection is being materialized under a shadow generation.

Field.Name: Active
Field.Description: The projection is committed and serving as the active generation.

Field.Name: Failed
Field.Description: Validation or projection failed; the last valid projection (if any) stays active.

Field.Name: Superseded
Field.Description: A newer generation has replaced this one; awaiting the configured retirement policy.

Field.Name: Retiring
Field.Description: Graceful retirement retains old-generation subscriptions, continuation points and in-flight operations until every use drains or migrates equivalently.

Field.Name: Retired
Field.Description: The projection has been removed from the AddressSpace.

UADataType.Description: How a registry or document triggers refresh of its derived projection.

Field.Name: Manual
Field.Description: Only an explicit Refresh Method call re-projects.

Field.Name: Periodic
Field.Description: The registry re-projects on a fixed interval (RefreshInterval).

Field.Name: EventDriven
Field.Description: The registry re-projects when a stored document changes (write/CloseAndUpdate).

Field.Name: Scheduled
Field.Description: The registry re-projects on an implementation-defined schedule.

UADataType.Description: The commit granularity applied when a refresh projects one or more documents.

Field.Name: PerResource
Field.Description: Each resource commits independently; a failure isolates to that resource.

Field.Name: PerGroup
Field.Description: All resources of a group commit together or not at all.

Field.Name: PerClosure
Field.Description: A dependency-safe activation closure, including inseparable ordinary-reference components and affected old/new replacement closure, commits atomically.

Field.Name: PerRegistry
Field.Description: All selected documents commit as a single all-or-nothing transaction.

UADataType.Description: How the registry treats dependents when a document version is unloaded or deleted.

Field.Name: Reject
Field.Description: Reject the operation while any other loaded document still depends on it.

Field.Name: Retire
Field.Description: Retire the projection but keep the stored document for dependents to resolve.

Field.Name: Cascade
Field.Description: Unload dependents that resolve only through this document.

Field.Name: Force
Field.Description: Force-unload the projection even while dependents remain, marking them Failed.

UADataType.Description: The outcome of a validation, projection or refresh operation on a document or the registry.

Field.Name: Success
Field.Description: The operation completed and changed the projection.

Field.Name: Unchanged
Field.Description: The complete effective input fingerprint and committed publication metadata matched; no repair or publication change was needed.

Field.Name: Warning
Field.Description: The operation completed with non-fatal warnings.

Field.Name: Skipped
Field.Description: The operation was not applicable and was skipped.

Field.Name: Rejected
Field.Description: The operation was rejected by policy (for example concurrency or delete policy).

Field.Name: Failed
Field.Description: The operation failed; the previous valid projection (if any) remains active.

UADataType.Description: The processing phase a document reached, used to locate where an outcome was produced.

Field.Name: Fetch
Field.Description: Reading document bytes and resolving registry-scoped context/schema references.

Field.Name: Parse
Field.Description: Parsing the JSON-LD document.

Field.Name: FormatValidation
Field.Description: Validating the document against its WoT-TD/WoT-TM format.

Field.Name: CompatibilityValidation
Field.Description: Validating the version against the resource compatibility policy.

Field.Name: DependencyResolution
Field.Description: Resolving the dependency closure (tm:extends, tm:ref, links rel=type).

Field.Name: Projection
Field.Description: Materializing types/instances into a shadow generation.

Field.Name: Activation
Field.Description: Committing the shadow generation as active.

Field.Name: Retirement
Field.Description: Applying the configured graceful or immediate retirement policy.

UADataType.Description: A single interaction operation a protocol binding supports, aligned with the WoT form op vocabulary.

Field.Name: ReadProperty
Field.Description: Read a property affordance.

Field.Name: WriteProperty
Field.Description: Write a property affordance.

Field.Name: ObserveProperty
Field.Description: Observe (subscribe to) a property affordance.

Field.Name: InvokeAction
Field.Description: Invoke an action affordance.

Field.Name: SubscribeEvent
Field.Description: Subscribe to an event affordance.

Field.Name: UnsubscribeEvent
Field.Description: Unsubscribe from an event affordance.

UADataType.Description: An immutable snapshot of a document's format and compatibility validation result. Read as a single Variant value; a new snapshot is produced on each validation and never mutated in place.

Field.Name: FormatValidated
Field.Description: True if format validation was performed.

Field.Name: FormatOutcome
Field.Description: Outcome of format validation (WoT-TD/WoT-TM conformance).

Field.Name: FormatReason
Field.Description: Human-readable reason for the format outcome (empty on success).

Field.Name: CompatibilityValidated
Field.Description: True if compatibility validation was performed.

Field.Name: CompatibilityOutcome
Field.Description: Outcome of compatibility validation against the resource policy.

Field.Name: CompatibilityReason
Field.Description: Human-readable reason for the compatibility outcome (empty on success).

Field.Name: CompatibilityPolicy
Field.Description: The compatibility policy in force (for example NONE, BACKWARD, FULL).

Field.Name: ValidatedAt
Field.Description: UTC time the validation completed.

Field.Name: VocabularyVersion
Field.Description: The pinned WoT Binding JSON-LD vocabulary version used for validation.

UADataType.Description: An immutable snapshot of a protocol binding's identity, version-pinned W3C document, maturity and supported operations. Held as an array element only for immutable snapshots; browseable binding objects (WoTBindingType) carry the live, per-field form.

Field.Name: BindingUri
Field.Description: The WoT protocol-binding vocabulary URI (for example the OPC UA, HTTP or Modbus binding).

Field.Name: Title
Field.Description: Human-readable binding title.

Field.Name: ProfileVersion
Field.Description: The version-pinned W3C binding document version this capability snapshot was built against.

Field.Name: DraftMaturity
Field.Description: The W3C maturity of the pinned binding document (for example WD, CR, PR, REC).

Field.Name: Capabilities
Field.Description: The interaction operations this binding supports.

Field.Name: ContentTypes
Field.Description: The content types this binding produces/consumes.

UADataType.Description: Immutable options controlling a single Refresh invocation.

Field.Name: Atomicity
Field.Description: Commit granularity for this refresh.

Field.Name: Force
Field.Description: Re-project even when the complete effective input fingerprint is unchanged.

Field.Name: DryRun
Field.Description: Validate and compute results without committing any projection change.

Field.Name: IncludeDependents
Field.Description: Also refresh documents that depend on the selected documents.

Field.Name: DeletePolicy
Field.Description: How to treat dependents when a selected document is unloaded/retired.

Field.Name: MaxParallelism
Field.Description: Maximum number of documents projected concurrently; 0 lets the server decide.

Field.Name: Timeout
Field.Description: Overall time budget for the refresh; 0 lets the server decide.

UADataType.Description: An immutable selector identifying which stored documents a Refresh applies to. An empty selector array selects the whole registry.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: Required Int32 enumeration: ThingDescription=0, ThingModel=1, All=2. Zero is ThingDescription, never an omitted field. All requires compatible model revision 1.2 or later and discovered selector support.

Field.Name: GroupId
Field.Description: Restrict to a group by groupid; empty selects all groups.

Field.Name: ResourceId
Field.Description: Restrict to a resource by resourceid; empty selects all resources.

Field.Name: VersionId
Field.Description: Restrict to a version by versionid; empty selects the resource's default version.

Field.Name: Xid
Field.Description: Select a single entity by its xRegistry xid within the Kind scope; overrides the other identity fields when set.

UADataType.Description: An immutable per-resource result row of a Refresh. Never mutated; the array is a point-in-time snapshot for one generation.

Field.Name: Xid
Field.Description: The xRegistry xid of the affected resource/version.

Field.Name: GroupId
Field.Description: The groupid of the resource's group.

Field.Name: ResourceId
Field.Description: The resourceid of the affected resource.

Field.Name: VersionId
Field.Description: The exact Version selected for consideration, including skipped results; an explicit selection is not replaced with the default Version.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: Whether the document is a Thing Description or a Thing Model.

Field.Name: Outcome
Field.Description: The per-resource outcome.

Field.Name: Phase
Field.Description: The actual phase reached by the selected exact Version, including the failing phase.

Field.Name: LoadState
Field.Description: The selected Version's resulting load state; a failed desired Version does not change the older valid Version whose projection is serving.

Field.Name: Generation
Field.Description: The actual final committed registry generation still serving; a failure does not identify a generation that never activated.

Field.Name: MaterializedNodeCount
Field.Description: Number of AddressSpace nodes materialized for this resource.

Field.Name: RootNodeId
Field.Description: The root node of the materialized projection, if any.

Field.Name: ContentDigest
Field.Description: The content digest (hash) of the projected document bytes.

Field.Name: Message
Field.Description: Human-readable detail for the outcome.

UADataType.Description: An immutable summary of one Refresh invocation, also carried by the WoTRefreshCompletedEventType and cached on the registry as LastRefreshSummary.

Field.Name: RequestId
Field.Description: The caller-supplied request identifier echoed back for correlation.

Field.Name: Generation
Field.Description: The actual final committed refresh generation; unchanged on dry run, no-op or full failure, including when the registry already has a non-zero generation.

Field.Name: Outcome
Field.Description: The overall outcome of the refresh.

Field.Name: Atomicity
Field.Description: The commit granularity that was applied.

Field.Name: StartTime
Field.Description: UTC start time of the refresh.

Field.Name: EndTime
Field.Description: UTC end time of the refresh.

Field.Name: Total
Field.Description: Total number of resources considered.

Field.Name: Succeeded
Field.Description: Number of resources that changed successfully.

Field.Name: Unchanged
Field.Description: Number of resources that were idempotently unchanged.

Field.Name: Failed
Field.Description: Number of resources that failed.

Field.Name: Skipped
Field.Description: Number of resources skipped by selection or policy.

Field.Name: Retired
Field.Description: Number of superseded generations retired.

UADataType.Description: An immutable raw dependency edge. Ordinary references may form legal co-activation SCCs; ordering constraints are checked separately. Snapshot Targets carry resolved identity pins.

Field.Name: SourceXid
Field.Description: The xid of the dependent document.

Field.Name: TargetXid
Field.Description: The origin-registry-relative xid of the pinned target Version; empty for unresolved or non-registry targets. Origin scope is carried separately in snapshot Targets.

Field.Name: TargetUri
Field.Description: The raw href/URI of the dependency as authored in the document.

Field.Name: RefType
Field.Description: The dependency kind (for example tm:extends, tm:ref, links.rel=type).

Field.Name: Resolved
Field.Description: True if the dependency resolved to a pinned registry or catalog/provider document.

UAObjectType.Description: The WoT Connectivity 1.2 registry root - an xRegistry RegistryType (a FolderType) that holds ThingDescriptionGroupType and ThingModelGroupType groups. The stored Thing Description / Thing Model files and their versions are canonical; the projected AddressSpace (types from Thing Models, instances from Thing Descriptions) is derived code-behind. Exposed as a well-known WoTRegistry object under the Server object (i=2253). Adds registry-wide refresh, generation and validation-policy state and the Refresh Method.

An xRegistry GroupType that collects related ThingDescriptionFileType resources (a Thing Description Group per the WoT xRegistry model). Adds the group-level format/compatibility validation policy. Its <ThingDescription> placeholder constrains members to the Thing Description subtype.

An xRegistry GroupType that collects related ThingModelFileType resources (a Thing Model Group per the WoT xRegistry model). Adds the group-level format/compatibility validation policy. Its <ThingModel> placeholder constrains members to the Thing Model subtype.

The abstract base used by a stable logical WoT document Resource and each exact Version - an xRegistry ResourceType (a FileType) whose JSON-LD bytes are read/written with the inherited Open/Read/Write/Close Methods. A logical Resource delegates its file and Version-view state to the selected default Version; an exact Version owns that state. Adds the derived-projection metadata (load state, desired/active version, validation and compatibility outcomes, content digest, materialized-node count and root, selected bindings) and the Validate, SetEnabled and SetDefaultVersion Methods. Concrete subtypes fix the document kind.

A concrete WoTDocumentType whose content is a W3C WoT Thing Description (WoT-TD/1.1, application/td+json). Projects to OPC UA instances: affordances become Variables, Methods and event sources; forms become binder plans. Adds the Thing instance identity (ThingId, base URI) and the link to the Thing Model it derives from.

A concrete WoTDocumentType whose content is a W3C WoT Thing Model (WoT-TM/1.1, application/tm+json). Projects to OPC UA types: it materializes an ObjectType or VariableType and the affordance member declarations and modelling rules. Adds the derived type NodeId and model version.

A browseable protocol-binding descriptor: the live, per-field representation of one W3C WoT protocol binding the server can realize (its URI, title, version-pinned W3C document, draft maturity, enabled state, content types and a capability snapshot). Selected/active binding sets are additionally exposed as immutable WoTBindingCapabilityDataType array snapshots. Policy and identity are browseable; no credentials or secrets are ever exposed here.

The abstract common base for WoT failure events. Carries the exact failing Version identity, document kind, actual phase, outcome and committed generation still serving. It is never emitted as a concrete lifecycle event.

Raised when an exact Version fails format or compatibility validation. SourceNode is that exact failing Version, including a rejected desired Version while another default/active Version serves. The stored document and previous valid projection are retained; Phase identifies the actual failure and Generation is the committed generation still serving.

Raised when an exact Version fails retrieval, materialization or activation. Retrieval exceptions before a document is returned report Fetch; a failed referenced input reports DependencyResolution for its dependent Version. SourceNode is that exact failing Version, not the stable Resource or a different serving Version. Phase identifies the actual failure; Generation is the committed generation still serving, not a generation that failed to activate.

Raised when an exact Version's form cannot be bound or binding readiness fails. SourceNode is that exact failing Version, including a non-default desired Version. Phase identifies the actual processing phase; Generation is the committed generation still serving. Failed/cancelled readiness leaves no registration without Subscription ownership.

Raised by the registry when an actual Refresh completes, including automatic and no-op refreshes. Carries the final committed Summary and Generation. SourceNode is the registry; a dry run returns diagnostics without this event.

UAReferenceType.Description: Links the stable logical WoT Resource (source), not an exact Version, to its active projection root (target). Provides registry/document RefreshGeneration correlation. Where WOTC-ModelChange is implemented, applicable namespace-0 NodeVersion Properties retain Core structural semantics, not a universal refresh counter.

UAVariable.Description: True if the registry automatically re-projects stored documents (per RefreshMode); false if only explicit Refresh calls re-project.
How automatic refresh is triggered when AutoRefresh is true.
The interval used when RefreshMode is Periodic.

The committed registry generation; advances once per actual publication unit, not on no-op, dry-run or failed work. Provides broader correlation than namespace-0 NodeVersion. Where WOTC-ModelChange is implemented, NodeVersion follows only the applicable Core structural rules.
UTC time of the last completed refresh.
An immutable snapshot summarizing the last completed refresh.
The commit granularity applied when a Refresh omits an explicit atomicity.
The default policy for treating dependents on unload/delete.
Registry-wide default: validate document format on ingest/refresh.
Registry-wide default: validate version compatibility on ingest/refresh.
If true, a validation warning is treated as a failure.
The version-pinned WoT Binding JSON-LD vocabulary this registry validates and projects against.
An immutable snapshot array of the protocol bindings currently selected/active registry-wide.

UAObject.Description: A folder of browseable WoTBindingType binding descriptors the server can realize (the live, per-field form of the selected-bindings snapshot).
A Thing Description Group held by this registry (constrained to the ThingDescriptionGroupType subtype).
A Thing Model Group held by this registry (constrained to the ThingModelGroupType subtype).

UAMethod.Description: Selection bounds work before fetching or planning. Compare the complete effective input fingerprint and publication metadata, not ContentDigest alone. Prepare dependency-safe atomic units and expose LastRefreshPlan before publication. Hold an invocation publication lease, recheck caller/preparation/input/lifecycle revisions, durably decide each unit and publish its complete prepared routing/metadata state before releasing notifications. Required activation prerequisites must satisfy their exact committed input pins before dependent units publish. WOTC-ModelChange structural and WOTC-SemanticChange applicable semantic notifications are conditional on the respective implemented CU and actual commit; NodeVersion is not a generic generation stamp. Immediate retirement ends Node access, not surviving MonitoredItem Service identity; valid deletion succeeds. Graceful retirement retains all old-generation uses until drained or equivalently migrated. Failure SourceNode is the exact failing Version and Generation identifies committed state still serving. A stale non-zero ExpectedGeneration fails Bad_InvalidState without publication; zero does not waive stale-plan protection. Empty Selection selects the registry; disabled resolution inputs are never activated.

Description.Text: The documents to refresh; empty selects the whole registry.
Options controlling atomicity, force, dry-run and dependents.
Expected current RefreshGeneration; 0 disables only caller equality, not preparation-generation or pinned-input/lifecycle rechecks.
Caller-supplied identifier echoed into the summary and the completion event.
The refresh summary.
The per-resource results.
The committed generation (unchanged on dry run or full failure).

Group-level policy: validate version compatibility on ingest.
Group-level policy: require all versions of a resource to share one format.

UAObject.Description: A Thing Description resource held by this group (constrained to the ThingDescriptionFileType subtype).

UAVariable.Description: Group-level policy: validate Thing Model format (WoT-TM/1.1) on ingest.
Group-level policy: validate version compatibility on ingest.
Group-level policy: require all versions of a resource to share one format.

UAObject.Description: A Thing Model resource held by this group (constrained to the ThingModelFileType subtype).

The registry generation at which this exact Version last committed a projection. Broader publication correlation than namespace-0 NodeVersion. Where WOTC-ModelChange is implemented, applicable stamping follows Core structural rules. A rejected desired Version does not replace the serving Version's committed state.
UTC time this document was last projected.

UAMethod.Description: Validate the stored document (format and, when enabled, compatibility) without changing its projection. Returns the outcome snapshot; also refreshes the ValidationOutcome Property.

UAMethod.Description: Set the desired Enabled state of this document. Enabling requests validation and projection; disabling requests unload per the registry DeletePolicy. If ExpectedEpoch is non-zero and does not equal the resource's current Epoch the call fails with Bad_InvalidState and changes nothing.

UAMethod.Description: Make a specific version of this resource its default (sticky) version, so that resolvers selecting the resource without a versionid resolve to it. This Method is invoked on the logical Resource; a call on an exact Version fails with Bad_NotSupported. If ExpectedEpoch is non-zero and does not equal the logical Resource's current MetaEpoch the call fails with Bad_InvalidState and changes nothing.

UADataType.Description: A pinned resolved dependency target. StructureWithOptionalFields is used solely for optional OriginRegistry; all remaining fields are required and scalar.

Field.Name: EdgeIndex
Field.Description: The index of the corresponding resolved edge.

Field.Name: OriginRegistry
Field.Description: Present only for a trusted registry target; absent for a pinned non-registry catalog/provider document.

Field.Name: VersionXid
Field.Description: The exact target Version's origin-relative Xid; empty for non-registry targets.

Field.Name: DocumentUri
Field.Description: The actual resolved location or authoritative document identity, not fetch permission.

Field.Name: VersionNodeId
Field.Description: The portable exact Version NodeId, distinct from the trusted origin's registry-root NodeId; null only when no OPC UA target Node exists.

Field.Name: ContentDigest
Field.Description: The complete content digest of the pinned target document.

UADataType.Description: One atomically read exact-Version dependency graph or last actual attempt. Committed and attempted values remain distinct; dry runs update neither.

Field.Name: SourceVersionId
Field.Description: The exact source Version represented by this snapshot.

Field.Name: Generation
Field.Description: The actual committed registry generation at this activation or completed attempt.

Field.Name: RequestId
Field.Description: The Refresh request identifier.

Field.Name: ResolvedAt
Field.Description: The time of the actual resolution attempt.

Field.Name: IsCommitted
Field.Description: True only for a successfully activated dependency graph.

Field.Name: EffectiveInputDigest
Field.Description: The full 32-byte fingerprint of all effective inputs; an incomplete failed preparation may have an empty digest.

Field.Name: Edges
Field.Description: Raw authored edges with registry-relative Xids and unchanged TargetUri values.

Field.Name: Targets
Field.Description: Exactly one pin per resolved edge, identified by EdgeIndex.

UAVariable.Description: The committed exact-Version dependency graph, replaced only after successful activation. Failed attempts and dry runs retain it. Conditionally Mandatory on exact Versions when WOTC-DependencySnapshots is supported. Logical Resource file-view reads delegate to its selected Version. Initially Bad_WaitingForInitialData; apply group/Version read and target-disclosure authorization.

The last completed actual dependency attempt, successful or failed. IsCommitted is false for a failed preparation; dry runs leave this value unchanged. Conditionally Mandatory on exact Versions when WOTC-DependencySnapshots is supported. Logical Resource file-view reads delegate to its selected Version. Initially Bad_WaitingForInitialData; apply group/Version read and target-disclosure authorization.

UADataType.Description: Correlated pre-publication planning diagnostics. Does not add a Refresh Method output or change Summary/Result layouts.

Field.Name: RequestId
Field.Description: The invocation whose final dependency-safe plan is being reported.

Field.Name: PreparationGeneration
Field.Description: The committed generation against which the plan was prepared/rechecked.

Field.Name: RequestedAtomicity
Field.Description: The caller's requested atomicity.

Field.Name: AppliedAtomicity
Field.Description: The actual dependency-safe atomicity selected before publication.

Field.Name: UnitCount
Field.Description: The number of independently committable planned units.

UAVariable.Description: The final dependency-safe plan exposed under the invocation publication lease before the first unit publishes. Conditionally Mandatory with WOTC-AtomicityModes; initially Bad_WaitingForInitialData. It is planning diagnostics, not committed projection metadata. Dry runs use existing Summary/Results and do not mutate this Property.

The final dependency-safe plan exposed under the invocation publication lease before the first unit publishes. Conditionally Mandatory with WOTC-AtomicityModes; initially Bad_WaitingForInitialData. It is planning diagnostics, not committed projection metadata. Dry runs use existing Summary/Results and do not mutate this Property.

UADataType.Description: The actual published host event-identity mode. LocalReEmission is the compatibility default; TransparentForwarding requires explicit host selection and successful identity-preserving admission. There is no fallback between modes.

Field.Name: LocalReEmission
Field.Description: Use a unique local occurrence identity and the declared local mapping.

Field.Name: TransparentForwarding
Field.Description: Preserve admitted source EventId and semantic identities without overlays.

UADataType.Description: Authorized out-of-band provenance for one retained occurrence. Optional source facts are omitted when unavailable, not fabricated. Transparent admission requires its source identity/time facts. This Structure never adds fields to a native or imported EventType and is not action-dispatch authority.

Field.Name: IdentityMode
Field.Description: The occurrence's actual producing mode, including retained generations.

Field.Name: BindingId
Field.Description: The exact binding in this descriptor's owning Version and generation.

Field.Name: Generation
Field.Description: The actual published active or retained generation, never a preflight generation.

Field.Name: SourceDocumentId
Field.Description: The pinned source document identity without embedded credentials.

Field.Name: SourceServerUri
Field.Description: The source server's verified logical identity when available.

Field.Name: SourceEventType
Field.Description: The captured semantic source EventType when available.

Field.Name: SourceNode
Field.Description: The captured source Node when available; a present null remains null.

Field.Name: SourceEventId
Field.Description: The exact source occurrence EventId when supplied.

Field.Name: SourceConditionId
Field.Description: The privately captured source Condition identity when available.

Field.Name: SourceBranchId
Field.Description: The captured source branch; present null denotes the main branch.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The source occurrence Time; absent for a local input that supplies none.

Field.Name: SourceReceiveTime
Field.Description: The upstream receipt time when available.

Field.Name: ReceiveTime
Field.Description: The receiving server's latest retained receipt time for this occurrence.

UAObjectType.Description: An out-of-band event binding descriptor owned by one exact WoT Version and actual publication generation. Instances describe active or retained bindings; preflight failures use existing Version diagnostics. It is not a ConditionType or an overlay on the source EventType.

UAVariable.Description: Stable binding identity within the exact owning Version/generation.
Actual producing mode; a failed desired mode is not advertised as active.
Positive actual published generation retained for this descriptor.
Pinned source document identity, without credential-bearing URLs.
Verified source server identity when available; required for transparent sources.
Current binding availability, including explicit identity/capacity/continuity failure.

UAMethod.Description: Read the latest retained provenance for EventId in this exact binding/generation. Check authorization first: Bad_UserAccessDenied for an unauthorized caller, then Bad_NoData for missing/expired evidence. Never return an empty success. The returned record does not grant source action authority.

Description.Text: The observed local or preserved EventId in this binding/generation.
The authorized retained occurrence's provenance with exact source-field presence.

UAObject.Description: Optional management container for published event bindings on an exact Version. Conditionally Mandatory for the event-identity CUs. A logical Resource view delegates to its selected Version; no future generation descriptor is created during preflight.
One active or retained exact-Version/generation/binding descriptor, not a source EventType extension.

UAObjectType.Description: An organizational occurrence of a projection, distinct from its canonical View. Organizes already-materialized selected Nodes without cloning them. ProjectionRoot identifies the canonical View, whose inverse HasWoTProjection leads to the logical Resource.

UAVariable.Description: The canonical projection View. This mandatory scalar Property does not replace RootNodeId or the logical Resource's HasWoTProjection Reference.

The full 32-byte SHA-256 of the injective sorted semantic-membership encoding. Conditionally Mandatory on logical projection Resources when WOTC-ProjectionMaterialization is supported. It is not a document digest, a truncated ViewVersion or an exact-Version dependency snapshot.
